_note: Fixed income-tax quota for EVERY bill label (16 expense categories + 12 document types). 'cap_path' points into config/tax_rules/fy<YYYY-YY>.json so the quota always matches the configured rules. quota=0 / claim_type=null means the label gives the employee no income-tax deduction. ESTIMATE ONLY: rules status is SECONDARY_SOURCES_ONLY; HR/payroll decides. Edit freely.

demo_rebate._note: TEMPORARY DEMO SWITCH (requested 'for the time being'): when enabled, labels that have NO statutory deduction (food, travel, utilities, fuel, hotel, medical, ...) are given a notional fixed yearly allowance so every bill shows a rebate. This is NOT an income-tax rule. The saving is computed with the real slabs as if the allowance reduced taxable income. Set enabled=false to restore the statutory-only behaviour.

rent.quota_text: No fixed rupee cap: exempt HRA = least of (HRA received, rent paid - 10% of basic, 50% / 40% of basic for metro / non-metro). Needs an HRA component in salary.

rent_receipt.quota_text: No fixed rupee cap: exempt HRA = least of (HRA received, rent paid - 10% of basic, 50% / 40% of basic for metro / non-metro). One claim per month; landlord PAN needed above Rs 1,00,000 annual rent.

rental_agreement.quota_text: Supporting document for HRA only - no amount of its own, so no separate rebate.

school_fee_receipt.quota_text: Shared Rs 1,50,000 annual 80C limit; tuition part only, max 2 children.

investment_certificate.quota_text: Shared Rs 1,50,000 annual 80C limit (PPF, ELSS, NSC, tax-saver FD, life insurance ...).

insurance_premium_receipt.quota_text: Rs 25,000/yr for self and family (Rs 50,000 if senior citizen) plus Rs 25,000 for parents; non-cash premium only. A life-insurance premium counts under 80C instead.

loan_interest_certificate.quota_text: Rs 2,00,000/yr for a self-occupied home; education-loan interest (80E) has no cap; EV-loan interest (80EEB) Rs 1,50,000 for loans sanctioned 1-Apr-2019 to 31-Mar-2023.

loan_statement.quota_text: Supporting evidence only; the lender's interest certificate is the claim document.

meal_voucher_statement.quota_text: Rs 200 per meal, employer-provided vouchers only; state the number of meals.

ev_document.quota_text: Rs 1,50,000/yr on EV-loan interest, only for loans sanctioned 1-Apr-2019 to 31-Mar-2023; employer EV lease/reimbursement is decided by payroll.

form_16.quota_text: Income / TDS evidence - not a deduction.

food.quota_text: Restaurant / food bill: no income-tax deduction (meal exemption applies only to employer meal vouchers - upload the voucher statement).

fuel.quota_text: Fuel bill: no income-tax deduction for the employee.

hotel.quota_text: Hotel bill: no income-tax deduction (reimbursement is employer policy).

flight.quota_text: Travel ticket: no income-tax deduction (reimbursement is employer policy).

train.quota_text: Travel ticket: no income-tax deduction (reimbursement is employer policy).

bus.quota_text: Travel ticket: no income-tax deduction (reimbursement is employer policy).

transport.quota_text: Local transport: no income-tax deduction (reimbursement is employer policy).

electricity.quota_text: Utility bill: no income-tax deduction for salaried employees.

gas.quota_text: Utility bill: no income-tax deduction for salaried employees.

water.quota_text: Utility bill: no income-tax deduction for salaried employees.

internet.quota_text: Internet / telecom bill: no income-tax deduction for salaried employees.

medical.quota_text: Hospital / pharmacy bill: not an 80D premium. Only health-insurance premiums and the Rs 5,000 preventive check-up count under 80D.

miscellaneous.quota_text: No income-tax deduction unless it is one of the tax documents above.

non_expense.quota_text: Not an expense bill and no tax-document type was recognised: no rebate.

default_profiles._note: Two saved employee profiles, seeded once into <HRBC_OUT>/hr/hr.db (INSERT only if missing, never overwrites edits) so they survive restarts. SYNTHETIC demo data.
